review: Only branch publication; no push selector matches this branch. Deploy/workflow_run chains not triggered. No PR or dispatch.

workflows.triggers:
on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/deploy.yml
      - .github/backup/**
      - .github/workflows/backup-transport-checks.yml
      - .github/workflows/tickets-backup.yml
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/deploy.yml
      - .github/backup/**
      - .github/workflows/backup-transport-checks.yml
      - .github/workflows/tickets-backup.yml
  workflow_dispatch:

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows: ["Deploy to Cloudflare"]
    types: [completed]
  workflow_dispatch:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      expected_source:
        description: Exact source just activated by the guarded VPS release
        required: true
        type: string
      activation_required:
        description: Require the successful VPS activation revision
        type: boolean
        default: true

on:
  push:
    branches: [improve/release-evidence-parallel-20261013]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      expected_source:
        description: Exact reviewed candidate SHA; branch movement must fail before candidate code executes
        required: true
        type: string
      trusted_base:
        description: Independently selected reviewed controls ancestor on main
        required: true
        type: string

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - "scripts/check-d1-recovery-runtime.mjs"
      - "scripts/rehearse-d1-recovery.sh"
      - "tests/d1-recovery-privacy.test.mjs"
      - ".github/workflows/d1-recovery-rehearsal.yml"
  schedule:
    - cron: "15 4 * * 0"
  workflow_dispatch:

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths: [package.json, package-lock.json, mobile/package.json, mobile/package-lock.json, .github/dependabot.yml, .github/workflows/dependency-security.yml]
  schedule:
    - cron: "30 5 * * 1"
  workflow_dispatch:

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    # Operator diagnostics do not change the application. Workflow-only release
    # configuration edits remain deployable through explicit workflow_dispatch.
    paths-ignore:
      # Recovery maintenance is not an application release.
      - '.github/workflows/d1-recovery-rehearsal.yml'
      - 'scripts/check-d1-recovery-runtime.mjs'
      - 'tests/d1-recovery-privacy.test.mjs'
      - 'docs/runbooks/d1-recovery.md'
      - '.gitignore'
      - 'tests/staff-app-launch.test.mjs'
      - 'ops/vps/operator_evidence.py'
      - 'ops/vps/test_operator_evidence.py'
      - '.github/workflows/tickets-backup.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/backup-transport-checks.yml'
      - '.github/backup/**'
      - '.github/workflows/tickets-vps-diagnostics.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/deploy.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/tickets-handover.yml'
      - 'ops/handover/**'
      - 'tests/handover-loopback-health.test.mjs'
      - 'docs/operations/dual-hosting.md'
      - '.github/workflows/tickets-release-operator-checks.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/browser-followup.yml'
      - 'tests/browser-environment.test.mjs'
      - 'tests/test_operator_retry_workflow.py'
      - 'ops/vps/test_code_release.py'
      - '.github/workflows/candidate-parallel-checks.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/tickets-code-release.yml'
      - 'ops/vps/candidate_build.py'
      - 'ops/vps/code-release.py'
      - 'ops/vps/parallel_candidate_retry.py'
      - 'ops/vps/parallel_candidate_retry_control.py'
      - 'ops/vps/test_candidate_build.py'
      - 'ops/vps/test_parallel_candidate_retry.py'
      - 'ops/vps/test_parallel_candidate_retry_control.py'
      - 'ops/vps/test_parallel_retry_admission.py'
      - 'tests/test_candidate_parallel_workflow.py'
      - 'ops/vps/test_yorkeway_release.py'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      trusted_base:
        description: Independently selected reviewed control-plane commit on main
        required: true
        type: string
